evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature reads ~374 °C and drifts monotonically to ~381.5 °C, physically inconsistent with column temperatures of 58-76 °C and 400 mbar operation
Reflux flow near zero (0.01-0.16 L/h) while distillate ~0.5 L/h, yet FYI702 reports ratio 2.7-3.9 — ratio inconsistent with measured flows
Column profile essentially flat/static over 20 min, no separation front movement

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature reading (or T701 sensor/wiring check) and a verified reflux flow measurement to confirm whether reflux is actually flowing; plus a distillate composition sample.
